notes:
Email is now one tool the agent can actually reason with, instead of five it had to guess between. Ask for anything - what's unread, what came in today, who you emailed last week, mark the marketing read, block a sender - and it picks the right thing instead of falling back to "I can't do that".

It also handles several asks in one message ("check my inbox and mark the marketing read") and no longer answers a question about your sent mail by searching your inbox.
